mapper.insert: INSERT INTO play_count (user_id, item_id, item_type, play_count, last_played_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{itemId}, #{itemType}, 1, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE play_count = IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, last_played_at, NOW()) >= 30, play_count + 1, play_count), last_played_at = IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, last_played_at, NOW()) >= 30, NOW(), last_played_at)

INSERT INTO play_count (user_id, item_id, item_type, play_count, last_played_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{itemId}, #{itemType}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE play_count = play_count + 1, last_played_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT play_count FROM play_count WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND item_id = #{itemId} AND item_type = #{itemType}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM play_count WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND item_type = #{itemType}
